speaker.jigoku_unit: Fighting Mecha (weekly, Six God Combination Godmars)

347:47.en: 「I'll knock you out of the sky!」
alternatives: I'll smash you into the ground!

347:70.en: 「I won't fall to the likes of you!」

alternatives: This is where you'll meet your end!
You are a blight upon the galaxy!
You too shall taste death's power!
I'll teach you what despair means!
My psychic power will crush you!
I can sense what's in your heart!
Know the terror of a psychic!

347:534.en: 「$$バッフル$$ sends you to death's realm!」

347:573.en: 「$$ゼッドファイナー$$, bury them!」

alternatives: This time, I'll finish you off!
If Mars falls, Earth is finished!

347:720.en: 「$$マーズ$$! You are destined to die!」

347:761.en: 「If $$ゴッドマーズ$$ falls, victory is ours!」

347:804.en: 「Begone to the dark world, $$ゴッドマーズ$$!」
alternatives: Vanish into the dark world, Godmars!
I'll dispose of Mars's allies first!
I'll scatter you puny little mechs!
Damn you, buzzing around like flies!

347:1076.en: 「If you hit me, I'll hit back!」
alternatives: You hit me, I hit back!
You hit us, we hit back!
Hit us, and we'll hit back!
You hit me, so I'll hit you back!

347:1214.en: 「Don't expect to make it home alive!」
alternatives: Don't think you'll make it home!
Then I'll attack from here too!
I'm at a disadvantage at this range!
I see right through your thoughts!
Heh! I can sense your panic!
You think that can hurt me?!
As if that could hurt me!

347:2021.en: 「That doesn't even count as a wound!」
alternatives: That barely counts as a scratch!
Don't celebrate just for hitting me!
That won't faze a Fighting Mecha!
Don't take a Fighting Mecha lightly!

347:2236.en: 「$$マーズ$$! Is that your psychic power?!」

347:2366.en: 「Grr! This is taking a bad turn!」

alternatives: How dare you hit my Fighting Mecha!
Ggh! Don't take this mecha lightly!
Ggh! Is this a fatal wound?!

347:2870.en: 「$$マーズ$$! Not before I've beaten you!」
alternatives: Mars! Not until I've defeated you!
